findings.title: Materials' 129% earnings bet is extreme
findings.body: Materials trades at 17.04x forward versus 38.95x trailing, a 56 percent compression that implies 129 percent earnings growth. That is the market underwriting a doubling of profits, a bet that looks thin given the sector's forward percentile sits at just 37.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' percentile gap is stark
findings.body: Consumer Staples' trailing P/E sits at the 88th percentile of its five-year range while the forward multiple is at the 40th, a 48-point gap. Analysts are pricing in 48 percent earnings growth, which would be a dramatic reversal for a defensive sector typically valued for stability.

findings.title: Health Care's week-long de-rating is abrupt
findings.body: Health Care's forward percentile fell 26 points in one week, landing at 71, even though its trailing percentile is 76. The 46 percent multiple compression implies 86 percent earnings growth, a forecast that clashes with the sector's sudden loss of favor.
